versions.changelog:
- Initial release of mmgame-material-upload: a batch upload tool for game assets on mmgame.woa.com.
- Supports two upload modes: batch image upload and single-by-single combination asset upload with auto form filling.
- Guides users through uploading process via an AI assistant or by using a direct script configuration.
- Provides detailed templates, size, and format requirements for supported asset types.
- Requires OpenClaw, Playwright MCP, and a logged-in mmgame.woa.com session.
